data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nawwal', meaning 'the new moon'. In Islamic tradition, the crescent moon signifies the beginning of a new lunar month. The name Nawel carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nawel usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Nawel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
